description: This PHP script handles the retrieval and display of email image attachments in the SuiteCRM system. It verifies request parameters and user access, determines the file's MIME type, and outputs the image content.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Represents a note entity in SuiteCRM, used here to retrieve email image attachments.

methods.name: retrieve_by_string_fields
methods.description: Fetches a Note record based on specified string fields, used here to verify email attachment notes.
